objs.name: document
objs.description: Document object representing documents in the P&R Management system (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The document name composed as <abbreviation>_<number per type>_<title>.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Versioning information; new version is created for content or attribute changes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the document lifecycle (e.g., editing, released).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) included in the document (e.g., Scope(s) printed in metadata).

attributes.name: relevant_companies_or_areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property relevant companies or areas of validity.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type of document (e.g., Policy, Guidelines, Procedural Instructions, Work Instructions).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template that can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: General information object that can be attached to a document (e.g., Additional Information, Attachment, Equippments).

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle and can be deleted without impacting the main document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and may trigger a new version.

objs.name: equippments
objs.description: Attachments with their own versioning that pass through the release process of the main document.
